findings.claim: The universal Tauri verifier requires a desktop icon file that is not added or listed in the reviewed source tree, so a clean checkout cannot pass `pnpm run verify:tauri-universal`.
findings.evidence: The verifier's `requiredPlatformFiles` includes `${APP_ROOT}/src-tauri/icons/icon.png`, but the diff adds no `examples/tauri-universal/src-tauri/icons/icon.png` file and the packet file_tree has no `examples/tauri-universal/src-tauri/icons/` entry; acceptance requires reproducible evidence and the constraints require focused verifier/tests to pass.
findings.suggested_fix: Add and track `examples/tauri-universal/src-tauri/icons/icon.png` (and any other generated icons required by Tauri), or remove/replace the verifier requirement with the actual tracked icon contract.
